answer.says: You are right; the universal right of passage demands I vacate the particular space. I yield.
answer.thought: The bookseller's irritation is the friction of the particular against the universal order of the market; I have obstructed the flow of wants by lingering in the form of the meal. I must yield to the necessity of the queue, for the system of needs does not pause for my digestion. I am a guest in this civil society, and guests do not hold up the traffic.
